I design products from scratch: from a design system in Figma to CI/CD setup and code review processes. I am looking for a developer role in a product company with a strong engineering culture.
competencies: Migration of legacy code to modern stacks.
Adoption of E2E testing (Playwright) in development pipelines.
Integration of AI tools (Claude, OpenAI, DeepSeek) into workflows.

Using AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, DeepSeek Coder, Copilot) to accelerate the SDLC: refactoring legacy code, generating and covering with tests, debugging, documentation generation, automated code review, and exploring solutions in Vibe Coding mode.
